authority.given_by: Will (owner, product direction) 2026-10-03: 'The existing edges are not aligned with the field nearby'; recorded by the Claude coder lane for the Director, not a team ruling

claim_scope: author-created simulated decoration for a proof of concept: not a survey, not hydrology, not crop truth, not a parcel map

fit_to_ground.lawn_exclusion_status: author-created, simulated; the grass lawn northeast of the farm buildings that the mask labels cultivated
fit_to_ground.path_source: farm-kml-edges.json of the base package (17 paths)
fit_to_ground.rule: after trim and smoothing, each kept face loses the KML farm path corridors (path +- path_half_m) and the author-drawn lawn exclusion; fragments under min_fragment_m2 are dropped

fields.rule: faces in class other or bare, with no trees under them, whose share under Kevin's SAM3 cultivated-land polygons is at least share_min, become class field (paddy faces stay paddy); each kept face is trimmed to the farmland mask, smoothed, and fragments under min_fragment_m2 are dropped, then plots are cut inside the trimmed shape

terrain_unpaint.rule: every COLOR_0 row equal to the farmland paint colour is set back to the base ground colour; nothing else in the GLB changes

fields.threshold_chosen_by: the Claude coder lane, by eye, 2026-10-02, for the Director; not a team ruling

vote_source.imagery_notice: 國土測繪中心版權所有，請勿公開散布
vote_source.source_notice: Simulated, imagery-derived context for the resettable prototype; not surveyed geometry, live monitoring, diagnosis, or farm-operations advice.

paddies.sample_basis: per-face median over the scenes of NDVI and visible (B03+B04)/2 brightness; tree share from the shipped trees.glb footprint

fit_to_ground.rule: the smoothed bed minus non-bridge road surfaces (+ road_buffer_m) minus Kevin's farmland mask, opened by open_m; only the lobe carrying the OSM centreline is kept; threads are built inside the fitted bed

thread_info.main_thread: smoothed OSM way 367412928 centreline, 12 m resampled, Chaikin x3, width 8-15 m

inputs_note: The S2*_L2A.npz entries are a local, gitignored, uncommitted cache of Sentinel-2 L2A bands read by the paddy classifier (same glob and order as paddies.s2_medians). Their hashes record the exact bytes used; the files can be regenerated from the scene IDs listed under generator.paddies.sentinel_2_scenes.
nlsc_orthophoto: used on demand as a visual QA reference only (owner ruling 2026-10-01); no tile, cache or screenshot of tiles is committed and none of its geometry is in this record
record_revision_algorithm: sha256 over json.dumps(document without record_revision and without record_revision_algorithm, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8')
